capture_selected_session: Analysis is limited to the selected recording.
capture_models_hint: The list comes from local Pi models.json, not an availability check. Use Other model for a built-in model. Enter adds a line; Ctrl+Enter starts analysis.
capture_terminal_hint: Opens the selected agent in a terminal with its normal permissions. The request is copied for pasting if needed. Provider usage may be charged; closing Loadlet does not stop that session.
capture_handed_off: Agent opened. The request is on the clipboard.
capture_agent_notice: Sends this period’s summary to the selected provider; usage may be charged.
capture_inline_hint: Analyze the selected period with your Pi model. Only a bounded summary is sent; the provider may charge usage. No tools or automatic actions. Recording continues; local models add load. Closing Loadlet cancels analysis.
capture_question_default: What could explain heat or slowdown in this recording?
capture_pi_missing: No installed agent found. Export or copy the report instead.
capture_agent_failed: The agent could not complete the analysis.
capture_hint: CPU 250–1000 ms, processes 1 s, GPU 2–5 s. Recording preference is saved; a new session starts after shell reload. Raw history: 24 h or 224 MiB. No automatic AI.
capture_coverage: %1 records · %2 detected gaps. Charts are reduced; peaks are retained.
capture_process_at: Processes sampled at %1 · 100% = one CPU core
capture_no_process: No matching process sample at the selected time.
capture_agent_hint: Starts a normal external agent session with its usual permissions. The chosen provider may receive the report and charge usage.
profile_invalid: Enter a name, whole percentages from 0 to 100, and a valid CPU limit.
profile_auto_edit_hint: Saving does not update the running automation. Turn automation off and on to use this preset; applying manually turns it off.
profile_auto_hint: Steam/Proton uses Games, then the return preset below. Applying a profile manually disables automation.
profile_auto_error: Automatic switching failed. Try enabling again.
profile_no_fans: No supported fan controls are currently available. Saved values are retained.
profile_editor_hint: Save first, then apply from Profiles. New profiles start with the selected preset’s values.
profile_hint: Save stores the preset without changing hardware. Empty GPU output restores automatic control when applied. Hot or missing telemetry requests full fan output.
profile_failed: Profile could not be applied. Check driver support or authentication.
fan_profile_hint: Enter an exact integer percentage and save. It is reapplied after reboot. At 80°C or without CPU telemetry, output rises to 100%. Restore removes the saved profile.
fan_profile_saved: Fan output saved. The profile remains active after closing Loadlet and after reboot.
sensor_history_error: Saved history could not be read. Current samples are shown when available.
fan_control_limits: Percent is controller output, not target RPM. Saved profiles persist after reboot. Timed boosts and five-second trials remain temporary; Restore removes the saved profile.
fan_identify_hint: 0% requests a stop for 5 seconds, then restores control. One channel at a time. Hot/missing CPU telemetry cancels the trial. Some fans keep spinning at 0%.
map_hint: Schematic layout, not your exact case. Click a part for sensors. Fan positions are assigned manually; no automatic connector identification.
map_no_sensors: No sensors are exposed for this part. A sleeping device may be unavailable.
map_assignment_hint: Choose the channel connected to this position and assign it below. Until mapped, all channels remain listed. This changes only the label, not fan speed.
title: Loadlet
board_temp_channel: Board temperature input %1 · physical location unconfirmed
compact_ram_strip_hint: Show RAM below the main tiles; hidden when RAM already has a tile.
chart_interaction: Hover to inspect, click to pin, drag to move. Arrows, Home/End select samples. Live or Escape clears selection.
fan_control_hint: IT8613 channel numbers are not confirmed CPU/case/SSD fan labels. A temporary boost never reduces the current duty and restores the previous state after its timer. Unlock once for 24 hours; existing passwordless sudo is reused. RPM readback does not identify the physical connector.
fan_action_sent: Request accepted. Check channel RPM; physical fan identity is not confirmed.
fan_action_failed: Control request failed or authentication was cancelled.
fan_control_unavailable: No supported motherboard fan controller is exposed. A root-owned fan-control adapter and model-supported driver are required.
sensor_recording_hint: Every 15 seconds, including while this panel is closed. Local history: up to 7 days / 20 MiB. No separate service.
sensor_recording_error: History could not be saved. Live readings remain available.
sensor_history_hint: Readings update about every 3 seconds while this tab is open. Graphs keep up to 12 minutes in memory, not on disk.
no_temperature_sensors: No readable temperature sensors. A sleeping GPU is not queried.
no_fan_sensors: The driver exposes no readable fan sensors. Missing readings do not mean a stopped fan.
fan_units_hint: RPM is shown when available. NVIDIA may report only a percentage, not physical RPM.
confirm_terminate: Send SIGTERM to %1 (PID %2)? The process can save work or exit gracefully.
confirm_kill: Force kill %1 (PID %2)? Unsaved data will be lost immediately.
settings_desc: Changes apply immediately and save to your Omarchy bar layout.
frequencies_desc: Display CPU, RAM and GPU clock frequencies.
open_expanded_desc: Start with GPU, storage and full process table.
reader_error: Could not read system metrics. Retrying…
blocked_owner: Only your own processes can be ended
icon_indicator_desc: Read CPU, memory and CPU temperature every 15 seconds while the panel is closed.
icon_heat_desc: Flames clear below %1 °C or when temperature data is stale.
icon_legend: Mouth: CPU left to right. Right eye: RAM bottom to top.
icon_split_legend: Left eye: CPU. Right eye: RAM. Six bottom-up steps. Exact values are in the panel.
icon_load_threshold_desc: Below %1%: no gauge fill. From the threshold: actual load, without rescaling. Only the CPU/RAM icons are affected.
icon_load_colors: 65%: theme accent. 85%: warning color, as in the panel.
icon_split_colors: Saturated theme colors. From 65%: brighter accent; from 85%: warning hue. The panel keeps its original colors.
icon_motion_desc: A 2-second wiggle. Hotter samples replay it every 15/10/5/3 seconds.
heat_steps: Four heat levels: the trigger, then +5/+10/+15 °C. More flames and more frequent movement.
diagnostic_journal_desc: CPU/RAM/heat: 15 s. Process candidates: 30 s. Pressure and CPU policies: 60 s. Adds background work even with icon sampling off.
diagnostic_retention: Local history: up to 7 days or 20 MiB. Disabled by default. GPU, fans and watts are not recorded.
diagnostic_write_failed: History could not be saved. Metrics still work; check the diagnostic status.
diagnostic_export_failed: Export failed. Enable history first and check local storage.
diagnostic_prompt: Read %1/AGENT-PROMPT.md and analyze the accompanying diagnostic export. Give evidence-backed recommendations, tradeoffs, verification and rollback. Do not apply changes or start other agents.
hints_compact: e details  ·  ↑/↓ select  ·  x end task  ·  s settings  ·  ? hide
hints_expanded: e collapse  ·  / search  ·  c/g/m/p/t/n sort  ·  ↑/↓ select  ·  x end task  ·  r refresh
language_fallback: This language is not translated yet. Untranslated text uses English.
memory_clean_hint: Linux reclaims cache when applications need memory. The cache figure includes file pages and reclaimable kernel objects; not all of it can be dropped. Cleanup does not free application memory or fix leaks. Inspect Processes by memory to find running applications; zombies have already released their application memory. Files may load more slowly after cleanup.
memory_clean_confirm: Flush pending file writes, then drop clean file cache and reclaimable kernel objects system-wide? Applications and swap stay untouched. System authentication is required.
memory_clean_running: Waiting for authentication or clearing cache…
memory_clean_unmeasured: Cache-clear request completed, but the result could not be measured.
memory_clean_failed: The operation could not be completed or its result confirmed.
memory_clean_denied: System authentication was cancelled or denied.
memory_clean_unknown: The request timed out or its result is unknown. Authorized kernel I/O may still finish; do not assume nothing changed.
memory_clean_busy: Another cache-clear operation is already running.
memory_clean_result_hint: These are system-wide snapshots. Other applications also change memory usage, and cache can grow again.
